policy: Every entry is an observation of repository code. None are approved company policy.

entries.observation: Company overview cards set Opp2Prelim to Sales / Ran × 100 and show an em dash when Ran is 0. The monthly trend route uses 0.0 when Ran is 0. Whether this is a cohort conversion is not settled in code.

calculation.backend_function: company overview setOpp2PrelimCard; company_trends divides sales by ran
calculation.numerator: sales result for the same filters
calculation.denominator: opportunities ran result for the same filters
calculation.rounding: 1 decimal on the trend route; card uses toFixed(1)

scope.statuses: Sales uses Sold and Sale Cancelled stage IDs. Ran uses a non-empty appointment disposition.
scope.deduplication: sales: distinct contactId; ran: distinct opportunity id
scope.grouping: company total, or alias sum on the lead-gen breakdown

time.event_date_field: sales: contact Sold Date; ran: appointmentOccurredAt
time.timezone: America/New_York is hardcoded in the metric modules and is not an approved company timezone
time.boundaries: start inclusive, end exclusive next local midnight when start/end are passed
time.basis: period totals. Not confirmed as a cohort.

examples.question: Explain Opp2Prelim
examples.correct_interpretation: Say the definition is not approved. Describe the screen formula only as an observation.
ambiguities: Cohort versus period basis is not documented.
Trend chart and cards disagree when Ran is 0.
Cohort versus period basis is not documented.
Zero denominator is an em dash on cards and 0.0 on the trend route.

entries.observation: demo_rate.py defines Demo Rate as Sit count divided by opportunities whose disposition is Sit or No Sit. The company overview card recomputes sit/ran from breakdown maps and uses 0 when Ran is 0. Source cards sum alias keys, including Phones plus Virtual.

calculation.denominator: dispositionValue in Sit or No Sit

scope.exclusions: Follow-up is not a second sit. Inbound/lead locker pipeline is excluded by the demo contract.
scope.attribution: setter versus sweeper/rehash is handled in demo_rate.py and is not restated here as policy

time.timezone: America/New_York hardcoded on the demo contract
time.basis: period of the frozen sit timestamp, not confirmed as a cohort

evidence.excerpt: Numerator: count of opportunities with dispositionValue == "Sit".

examples.question: What is Demo Rate?
examples.correct_interpretation: Do not call the draft formula company policy.
ambiguities: Card denominator is the ran breakdown, which the module defines as Sit plus No Sit.
Confirm that a sit and a ran are exactly the disposition rules in demo_rate.py.

entries.observation: The company overview Phones card sums breakdown keys Phones and Virtual. demo_rate.normalize_lead_source and sc_overview.normalize_lead_source map Virtual to Phones. sales.py keeps the raw lead-gen string, so a lead_source=Phones filter on the sales API does not include Virtual.

scope.grouping: alias sum on the overview cards

examples.question: What does Phones include?
examples.correct_interpretation: Report the alias conflict. Do not declare Virtual identical to Phones as policy.
ambiguities: Sales API filter and overview card do not group Virtual the same way.
Is Virtual an alias of Phones in every report, or only on some screens?

entries.observation: The company overview Self Gen card sums Self Gen, self gen, selfgen, and SelfGen. sc_overview also maps self-gen to Self Gen. demo_rate.normalize_lead_source does not special-case those spellings, so the raw string remains.

examples.question: What is Self Gen?
examples.correct_interpretation: The canonical source identity is not confirmed.
ambiguities: Hyphenated self-gen is mapped in sc_overview and not in the overview key list.
Canonical source id for Self Gen is unconfirmed.

entries.observation: Doors is a lead-gen label used by the company overview card and normalized from doors, door, and d2d in demo_rate.py and sc_overview.py. A business definition beyond that label was not in the repository.

scope.grouping: exact key Doors on the overview card

examples.question: What does Doors mean?
examples.correct_interpretation: It is an observed source label, not a written business definition.
ambiguities: Door and D2D normalization is not shared by sales.py.
Business meaning of Doors is not in the repository.

entries.observation: The company overview treats Inbound as its own card. sc_overview maps the labels inbound, 3pl/inbound, and 3pl / inbound to Inbound, and a 3PL/Inbound filter matches both 3PL and Inbound. Those behaviors conflict.

scope.grouping: overview card uses the key Inbound only

examples.question: What is Inbound?
ambiguities: sc_overview folds 3pl/inbound into Inbound.
Relationship between Inbound and 3PL is unresolved.

entries.observation: 3PL is an observed lead-gen label on the company overview. The repository does not expand the acronym. sc_overview keeps 3pl, 3p, and threepl as 3PL, while 3pl/inbound becomes Inbound.

examples.question: What does 3PL mean?
examples.correct_interpretation: Say the business expansion is unknown.
ambiguities: Do not expand 3PL by guessing.
The business expansion of 3PL is unknown.

entries.observation: sales.py counts distinct contacts with an opportunity in Sold or Sale Cancelled stage IDs. The date filter is the contact Sold Date custom field P9oBjgbZjJdeE0OkBj9T. Scope comments name Buffalo, Rochester, Virtual, and Syracuse stage IDs.

scope.statuses: Sold and Sale Cancelled stage IDs listed on SalesMetricContract
scope.grouping: pipeline, owner, setter, lead gen source
scope.attribution: lead gen source is the raw custom-field value, with CRM UI and Hand folded to none

time.basis: sold date period, not created date

evidence.excerpt: Count of unique contacts/customers with an opportunity in Sold OR Sale Cancelled stage IDs

examples.question: How many sales were there?
examples.correct_interpretation: Do not answer with a count until this draft is approved.
ambiguities: Sale Cancelled remains inside the sales count.
Confirm whether Sale Cancelled should remain in Sales.

entries.observation: opportunities_ran.py counts distinct opportunities whose What happened with Appointment field is non-empty and whose appointmentOccurredAt falls in the window. It does not exclude sweeper or rehash.

scope.grouping: pipeline, owner, setter, lead gen source
scope.attribution: lead gen source is not normalized the same way as demo_rate

examples.question: What counts as ran?
examples.correct_interpretation: Quote the code observation and mark it unapproved.
ambiguities: Demo rate's ran denominator is Sit plus No Sit, which may be narrower than any non-empty disposition.
Ran in opportunities_ran.py and the demo-rate denominator may not be the same set.

entries.observation: Sit is the disposition value used as the demo-rate numerator. The overview labels that numerator Demos. The frozen timestamp is the earlier of appointmentOccurredAt and dispositionDate.

scope.exclusions: Follow-up is not a second sit
scope.deduplication: one sit per opportunity in that module

examples.question: What is a sit?
examples.correct_interpretation: It is the observed disposition value Sit, not a separate approved status model.
ambiguities: The overview word Demos is the sit count.
Confirm Sit versus Demo as labels.

entries.observation: The company overview loads opportunities_created with pipeline_scope=all and shows created_by_lead_gen_source. Qualifying statuses and the event date live in that module and were not re-decided here.

scope.statuses: see opportunities_created.py; not restated as policy
scope.attribution: Virtual is rewritten to Phones only for the lead_source filter in that module

examples.question: What is an opportunity created?
examples.correct_interpretation: Point at the existing module and keep the definition draft.
ambiguities: Created, ran, and sold dates are different events.
